paper_statement: Across the 150 (epsilon, delta) settings in Table 1, the best K in {1,...,20} multi-Gaussian has lower expected l1 loss than the analytic Gaussian in 142 settings; the all-setting improvement has mean 53.73%, population standard deviation 34.86 percentage points, and median 61.86%.
baseline_verifier_scope: Checks the exact source table and its aggregate arithmetic. It is not independent scientific evidence and cannot verify Claim 1 by itself.
pass_conditions: 142 positive entries when the eight paper NA cells are treated as no strict improvement
